rationale: David and Syed both bring deep robotics engineering expertise from different angles—David from shipping autonomous systems end-to-end (drones at Skycatch, tractors at Agtonomy) and building real-time infrastructure for production robotics, and Syed from applied AI/robotics work at GM with hands-on experience in ROS2 and real-time visualization tools. As judges at this event, they can offer complementary perspectives on production robotics challenges, from infrastructure and observability (David's conviction) to path planning and temporal analysis (Syed's background), and might identify interesting synergies in how real-time systems and AI interact in deployed autonomous systems.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Syed Mohammad Asjad — you both have rare production robotics shipping experience (David from drones and tractors, Syed from GM's autonomous systems), and your work on real-time infrastructure and ROS/AI systems could spark useful insights for evaluating teams here.
